result.title: The Complexity of Oracle-Efficient Realizable Transductive Learning
result.summary: In realizable transductive online learning, the learner knows the entire sequence of $T$ instances in advance, and the labels are consistent with one of $N$ hypotheses. With explicit access to the hypothesis class, the halving algorithm makes at most $\log_2 N$ mistakes. Can a comparable guarantee be achieved using only polynomially many empirical risk minimization (ERM) queries? We answer this question negatively, even for a weighted-ERM oracle that optimizes arbitrary real-valued linear objectives and returns a complete maximizing hypothesis. For every fixed $β\in(0,1)$ and every randomized learner making polynomially many oracle queries, there exists a fixed realizable instance with exactly $N=2^{\lfloor T^β\rfloor}$ hypotheses on which the learner makes $Ω_β(\sqrt{T\log N})$ mistakes in expectation. This matches the agnostic-rate upper bound achieved by random playout using $O(T)$ oracle calls. The separation persists for much smaller classes as well: along a sequence with $\log N=Θ((\log T)^2)$, we establish a mistake lower bound of $\exp(Ω(\log T/\log\log T))$. Our main technical contribution is a composition lemma that combines two realizable prediction problems such that their mistake lower bounds add, up to a small loss, while their hypothesis class sizes grow only additively. Iterating this lemma yields a family of hard instances spanning the desired parameter regimes, establishing a sharp separation between information-theoretic and oracle-efficient mistake guarantees.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究可实现直推式在线学习中，仅允许多项式次 ERM oracle 查询的学习器能否达到与显式访问假设类相当的错误界；作者用组合引理构造困难实例，给出了 Ω(√(T log N)) 的期望错误下界，并指出与随机 playout 上界之间的尖锐分离。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉或多模态推理无直接关系，但其「信息论可达 vs 有限 oracle 查询可达」的分离，可能为 LVR 中有限次外部调用（如搜索、验证、证据获取）所能带来的收益上限提供概念参照，需较多核查。
